days.name: Day 1
days.description: Opening day at Nagarro Gurgaon Office with Chairman and CEO key sessions.

days.name: Day 2
days.description: Hands-on labs, architecture deep dives, and delivery stories.

days.name: Day 3
days.description: Community day with AMAs and innovation showcases.

floorStories.B: Basement parking — 40 car bays and 100 bike slots. Take central lifts to Reception on Ground.
floorStories.G: Welcome to Reception & Welcome Hall — parking entry, registration help desk, and keynote space.
floorStories.1: 1st floor parking — car and bike bays with lift access to the event tower.
floorStories.2: 2nd floor parking — often has good bike availability during peak arrival.
floorStories.3: 3rd floor parking — mid-stack car bays; central lifts to session floors.
floorStories.4: 4th floor parking — top parking deck before the wellness floor.
floorStories.5: Wellness floor — open-air garden, fountain, and light snacks. A quiet break from sessions.
floorStories.6: North wing: full Community Cafeteria. South wing: training rooms, library, gym, and refresh corner. Lunch lightning talks at 12:00.
floorStories.7: Sitting area pods begin — North and South wings, 6 zones each.
floorStories.8: Pod rooms continue on both wings — popular for architecture and delivery tracks.
floorStories.9: Mid-tower collaboration floors with mixed pod sizes and breakout zones.
floorStories.10: Practice leadership sessions and customer storytelling rooms cluster here.
floorStories.11: Innovation showcases and hands-on demo labs — busy in afternoon slots.
floorStories.12: Executive briefings and partner roundtables across North and South wings.
floorStories.13: Top-floor AMAs and closing celebrations — check Now/Next for live keynotes.
